sources.title: GitHub - Rhombus-AI/.github
sources.snippet: Rhombus is a self-reliant AI organization founded by a 16-year-old, Akshit, with a mission to learn by building, and build by inventing. We don't wait for tools — we make our own. We don't just fine-tune — we research and train models from scratch. Rhombus is built to be like Iron Man's lab — anything we need, we build ourselves.
